name: Agent Forge
summary: Personas and skills, read from the .claude/ directories the CLI itself loads for a conversation's working directory. Three contributions across two hosts: claude-workspace.panel (the roster, and binding a persona to a conversation), claude-workspace.composer-action (paste the compiled brief into one message), and claude.context-provider (the bound persona, folded into the system contract on the first turn) — the last declared in plugin.server.ts because it reads the filesystem and plugin.ts is evaluated in the browser bundle.
